background: Gatehouse Bank is a small UK Sharia-compliant bank owned by Kuwaiti shareholders, funded by retail savings and lending on residential and buy-to-let property, with a build-to-rent investment arm.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the bank. Capital is mixed against UK small banks: CET1 of 17.1% is at the median, but leverage of 7.4% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 448% and NSFR of 154% both at the medians of a group that runs very high liquidity. Since 31 Dec 2021 CET1 has fallen 1.0 points and leverage 1.8 points while LCR has risen 83 points, so the bank has grown its book faster than its capital. The figures run to 31 Dec 2024. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. An unrated name where the leverage figure is the one to watch.
